examples:
### Name: separate_rows
### Title: Separate a collapsed column into multiple rows
### Aliases: separate_rows

### ** Examples

df <- tibble(
  x = 1:3,
  y = c("a", "d,e,f", "g,h"),
  z = c("1", "2,3,4", "5,6")
)
separate_rows(df, y, z, convert = TRUE)

# Now recommended
df |>
  separate_longer_delim(c(y, z), delim = ",")
